lanes.summary: The diff correctly implements the model capability ladder as requested in ticket PMAT-3477. It adds the required scripts to run the ladder tests and checks the receipts strictly against the defined rules (e.g., verifying fallbacks, empty executions, missing receipts, stale versions, and enforcing that the main ladder cannot be shrunk). All self-test coverage covers these edge cases accurately, and the documentation is updated to match. No weakened gates or unexpected behavior were found.

Audit of PMAT-3477 (PR #3479, EPIC #3477) concludes with verdict PASS. The diff establishes the Model Capability Ladder contract (contracts/model-capability-ladder-v1.yaml), runner script (scripts/model_ladder.sh), gate checker (scripts/check_model_ladder.sh), Cargo.toml dogfood gate registration, T-2 Models release specification row, 13 self-test discrimination cases, and verified 0.68.1 birth receipts. All 8 contract falsification obligations (FALSIFY-MCL-001 through FALSIFY-MCL-008) were verified and measured. Scripts are clean under bash -n, shellcheck, and bashrs lint (0 errors). No gate weakening or unauthorized changes detected.

scripts/check_model_ladder.sh is declared in Cargo.toml under [package.metadata.dogfood] gates without altering or weakening existing gates (FALSIFY-MCL-002)

scripts/check_model_ladder.sh --self-test passes all 13 discrimination cases with 0 errors, validating anti-vacuity and proper failure modes (FALSIFY-MCL-003, FALSIFY-MCL-004, FALSIFY-MCL-005, FALSIFY-MCL-007)
scripts/model_ladder.sh pins binary via scripts/apr_bin.sh and captures status without pipes (FALSIFY-MCL-006), correctly detecting backend fallback and skipped QA gates
Running check_model_ladder.sh against committed 0.68.1 receipts on lambda and gx10 exits 1 with RED for qwen3-1.7b and qwen35-0.8b, establishing red-capability on the birth tree (MCL-INV-003)
